manifest.title: CEA Daily Renewable Generation · All India · 90-report snapshot
manifest.publisher: Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, Government of India
manifest.method: Read only the All India row (47), daily columns B–D, from each archived daily report's Generation sheet; retain source row/cell and report-level SHA-256. Column E is used only for source-total reconciliation.

reconciliation.definition: Wind + Solar + Other RES compared with CEA's published All India daily total, per report.

manifest.caveat: Historical snapshot of published daily reports; not live data. RE-PREDICT is independent and not endorsed by CEA. Other RES is CEA's combined category; do not disaggregate it into biomass, bagasse, and small hydro without underlying data.
